# unifi_channel_plan (Resource)

The `unifi_channel_plan` resource manages a channel plan in the UniFi controller.

~> **Advanced.** A channel plan is normally the *output* of the controller's RF channel optimization: `date` is the generation timestamp and `radio_table` assigns a channel, tx-power and width to each radio, keyed by the runtime `device_mac`. Manage this resource only when you intend to author a fixed channel plan explicitly; otherwise let the controller generate it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Advanced: a fixed, manually-authored channel plan.
# A channel plan is normally generated by the controller's RF optimization; only
# manage this resource when you intend to pin channel assignments explicitly.
resource "unifi_channel_plan" "fixed" {
  radio_table = [
    {
      device_mac    = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff"
      name          = "rai0"
      channel       = "36"
      tx_power      = "auto"
      tx_power_mode = "auto"
      width         = 80
    },
    {
      device_mac    = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff"
      name          = "ra0"
      channel       = "6"
      tx_power      = "auto"
      tx_power_mode = "auto"
      width         = 20
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `date` (String) The channel plan generation timestamp (RFC3339-like `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`), or empty. Usually set by the controller when the plan is generated.
- `radio_table` (Attributes List) The per-radio channel assignments that make up the plan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--radio_table))
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--radio_table"></a>
### Nested Schema for `radio_table`

Optional:

- `channel` (String) The assigned channel, or `auto`.
- `device_mac` (String) The MAC address of the radio's device.
- `name` (String) The radio name (for example `ra0`, `rai0`).
- `tx_power` (String) The transmit power (a number) or `auto`.
- `tx_power_mode` (String) The transmit power mode. One of `auto`, `medium`, `high`, `low`, `custom`.
- `width` (Number) The channel width in MHz. One of `20`, `40`, `80`, `160`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import from provider configured site
terraform import unifi_channel_plan.fixed 5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217

# import from another site
terraform import unifi_channel_plan.fixed another-site:5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217
```
